claim_boundary: fixed-weight localization versus global-geometry discrimination; no carrier mechanism, route mechanism, or causal claim
fitting_boundary: Fit all six base-order channel trackers and the carrier nuisance model only on base-order train32. Apply unchanged to paired eval32 in both primary arms.
atomic_metric: per-history mean squared frozen endpoint-tracker residual across the channel coordinates; scale is population SD over base train32 atomic values
nuisance_model: base-train ridge alpha1 predicts carrier atomic residual from per-history full-state endpoint displacement norm and delay8 full-state norm; residualize unchanged in both arms
localization_gate: carrier_localized only if in at least 5/6 seeds: absolute carrier standardized contrast exceeds every noncarrier standardized contrast, and residualized carrier base-minus-upstream contrast is negative. Otherwise classify as broad/global endpoint association and stop the carrier causal path.
controls: save raw states and fitted nuisance model
